h1:
给平面设计师的 AI 设计工具。
每一层都能接着改。

AI design for graphic designers.
Every layer stays editable.

For Apple Silicon Macs · App signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple
trust1: Apple Silicon 原生 · 应用已通过 Apple 公证
Built for Apple Silicon · App notarized by Apple
trust2: 设计稿、版本和对话都留在你的电脑上
Design files, versions and chats stay on your computer
trust3: 用你自己的模型和密钥，不需要 Molly 账户
Your own models and keys. No Molly account
trust4: 在应用里检查更新，也可以随时手动下载
Check for updates in the app, or download any time
demo_h: 在 Molly 里直接录屏、截图
demo_lead: 不是效果图。一段是改一个词的录屏，一张是展开的导出菜单。
Not mockups. One screen recording of changing a word and one screenshot of the Export menu.
wf_lead: 按平时接活的顺序走一遍：写需求、找设计灵感、挑方向、落图层、客户回修、导出。
One job in the order you’d actually work it: brief, design inspiration, direction, layers, revisions, export.
wf_end: 客户下一轮改稿来了，你打开的还是同一份源文件。
When the next round of changes comes in, you open the same working file.
p1_h: 不是压平的单张图，是能接着做的源文件
Not a flat image. A real working file
p1_lead: 多数生图工具只给一张压平的图，改一行字就得重来。Molly 给你的是真文字、矢量形状和一层图片，都在同一份稿里。
Most image tools hand back a flat picture, so changing one line of copy means starting over. Molly gives you real text, vector shapes and one image layer in the same file.
p1_b1: 标题、日期、地点都是文字图层，选中就能改字、换字体、调字号和对齐。
Titles, dates and venues are text layers. Select one to reword it or change the font, size and alignment.
p1_b2: 圆、线和小图形是独立的矢量图层，可以单独移动和改色。
Circles, rules and small marks are separate vector layers you can move and recolour on their own.
p1_b3: 图片模型只出画面那一层，标题和小字不会被画进图里。
The image model only makes the picture layer. Headlines and small print are never baked into it.
p2_h: 先找设计灵感，再出方向
p2_lead: 排版之前，Molly 先用内置浏览器找设计灵感，再把几套方向并排摆出来。你选一套，它就按那套出稿。
Before laying anything out, Molly searches for design inspiration in its built-in browser and puts a few directions side by side. Pick one and it builds that one.
p3_h: 设计稿和密钥都在你的电脑上
Your design files and keys stay on your computer
p3_lead: 设计稿、版本和对话都存在本地。模型请求直接发给你自己配置的服务商。
Design files, versions and chats are stored locally. Model requests go straight to the providers you set up.
p3_l1: 设计稿、版本和对话都存在本地，不需要 Molly 云账户。
Design files, versions and chats are stored locally. No Molly cloud account.
p3_l2: 密钥存在系统加密存储里。第一次启动时，macOS 可能会请求允许 Molly 使用钥匙串，选「始终允许」即可。
Keys are kept in the system’s encrypted storage. On first launch macOS may ask to let Molly use the Keychain. Choose Always Allow.
p3_l3: 对话模型和图片模型的费用由你配置的服务商直接收取，Molly 不代收，也不转售。
The providers you configure bill you directly for chat and image model use. Molly doesn’t collect or resell it.
p3_l4: 换电脑或备份时，设计稿和数据可以直接拷走；加密保存的密钥可能要在新机器上重新填一次。
When you back up or move to a new computer, your design files copy over like any other files. Encrypted keys may need to be entered again on the new machine.
cases_h: 都是在 Molly 里做的
cases_lead: 下面每一张都是在 Molly 里做完、直接导出的。品牌和活动都是虚构的。
Every piece below was built and exported in Molly. Brands and campaigns are fictional.
m_lead: 在设置 → AI 模型里添加连接。每个会话可以单独选连接、模型和思考强度。
Add connections under Settings → AI models. For each session you pick the connection, the model and how hard it thinks.
m_img: 在图片生成里填兼容的接口地址、密钥和模型名称。它和对话模型分开设置，两个都填好才能发送需求。
Under Image generation, add a compatible endpoint, key and model name. It’s set up separately from the chat model, and you need both before you can send a brief.
final_p: 免费下载。应用经 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证。
Free to download. The app is signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

why: 像给同事交代需求一样
The way you’d brief a colleague
p: 选好尺寸，用一两句话说清楚做什么、给谁看、要什么感觉。内置方图、竖版、竖屏、横版和长图几种尺寸，也可以交给 Molly 判断。
Pick a size and say in a sentence or two what it is, who it’s for and how it should feel. Square, portrait, story, landscape and long-image presets are built in, or let Molly decide.
需要的时候，Molly 会打开内置浏览器找设计灵感，比如维基共享资源里的公版老照片和海报，再逐条说明从每一张里借鉴了什么。
When the job calls for it, Molly opens the built-in browser to look for design inspiration, such as public-domain photos and posters on Wikimedia Commons, and notes what it took from each one.
alt: Molly 在对话里列出为暗房开放日海报找到的公版参考图，右侧内置浏览器开着维基共享资源的图片页
Molly lists the public-domain reference images it found for a darkroom open-house poster, with a Wikimedia Commons file page open in the built-in browser

p: Molly 把几套方向并排放在画布上，每套附一段思路。你选一套，它就按那套出稿。
Molly lays a few directions side by side on the canvas, with a note on each. Pick one and it builds that one.
alt: 画布上并排的三套社区暗房开放日海报方向，左侧对话里是 Molly 对每套的说明
Three directions for a community darkroom open-house poster side by side on the canvas, with Molly’s note on each in the chat

why: 文字、形状、图片各占一层
Type, shapes and images each get a layer
p: 选定的方向会做成分层稿：文字是真文字，圆和线是矢量形状，背景是一层图片。每一层都在图层面板里，可以选中、对齐，也可以输入精确数值。

The chosen direction is built as a layered file: real text, vector shapes and one image layer for the background. Every layer sits in the Layers panel, where you can select it, align it and type exact values.
alt: Molly 画布上一张设计周横版主视觉，下方是图层、文字和形状工具
A design-week key visual on the Molly canvas, with the layer, text and shape tools below

why: 每一轮改的都是同一份源文件
Every round, the same working file
p: 客户要换个词，选中文字直接改。改动大一点就在对话里交给 Molly，不满意还能回到之前保存的版本。
If the client wants a different word, select the text and retype it. For bigger changes, ask Molly in chat, and go back to an earlier saved version if the result isn’t right.
alt: 咖啡海报的标题已改成 honey oat，文字框仍选中，右边图层面板显示同名图层
A café poster with its headline changed to “honey oat”, the text box still selected and the matching layer highlighted in the Layers panel

why: PNG or JPEG at three scales
p: 保存后导出。交给客户的是导出的图，可编辑的源文件和历史版本留在你的电脑上，下一轮接着改。
Save, then export. Your client gets the exported image. The working file and its saved versions stay on your computer for the next round.

faq: 系统要求是什么？
What do I need to run it?
一台 Apple Silicon 芯片的 Mac，系统为 macOS Ventura 或更新。目前不支持 Intel Mac。
A Mac with Apple Silicon running macOS Ventura or later. Intel Macs aren’t supported.
怎么安装？
How do I install it?
下载 DMG，打开后把 Molly.app 拖进「应用程序」。应用经 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证，可以直接打开。
Download the DMG, open it and drag Molly.app into Applications. The app is signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so it opens normally.
要付费吗？模型费用谁出？
Does it cost anything? Who pays for the models?
Molly 可以免费下载。对话模型和图片模型的调用费用，由你配置的服务商直接向你收取，Molly 不代收也不转售。
Molly is free to download. The providers you configure bill you directly for chat and image model use. Molly doesn’t collect or resell it.
我的设计稿和对话会上传到 Molly 吗？
Do my design files and chats get uploaded to Molly?
不会。设计稿、版本和对话都存在本地，Molly 没有云账户。模型请求直接发给你配置的服务商。
No. Design files, versions and chats are stored locally, and Molly has no cloud account. Model requests go straight to the providers you configure.
支持哪些模型？
Which models can I use?
取决于你添加的连接：OpenAI、Kimi Code，以及任何 OpenAI 兼容接口（包括本地的 Ollama、LM Studio）。图片模型单独设置，首次启动时和对话模型一起接上。具体能用哪些，看服务商和你的密钥。

That depends on what you connect: OpenAI, Kimi Code and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including local Ollama and LM Studio. The image model is set up separately, and you connect it alongside the chat model on first launch. The exact list depends on the provider and your key.
需要图片模型吗？
Do I need an image model?
需要。首次启动时接上对话模型和图片模型，两个都配好才能开始做稿。
Yes. On first launch you connect a chat model and an image model. Molly needs both before it can start a design.
和直接让聊天 AI「做张海报」有什么不同？
How is this different from asking a chat AI for a poster?
在聊天工具里出图，通常拿到的是一张压平的图。Molly 先找设计灵感、并排给几套方向，再把选中的方向做成可编辑的图层：可以对齐、改字、回到旧版本，最后在本机导出 PNG 或 JPEG。

A chat tool usually hands you one flat image. Molly looks for design inspiration, puts a few directions side by side and builds the one you pick as editable layers. You can align, retype and roll back, then export PNG or JPEG on your computer.
能做印刷稿吗？
Can I make print files?
目前尺寸用像素预设，没有出血和毫米单位，更适合屏幕和社媒用途。
Sizes are pixel presets for now, with no bleed or millimetre units, so it suits screen and social work best.
怎么更新？
How do I update?
在应用里检查更新，也可以随时在本页重新下载 DMG。
Check for updates in the app, or download the DMG again from this page at any time.
